title: 2 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 13
description: Ten questions on 2 Samuel 13: Amnon and Tamar, Absalom's revenge, and his flight to Geshur.

questions.text: Who was Amnon's friend, described as a very subtle man?
questions.explanation: Amnon had a friend whose name was Jonadab, the son of Shimeah, David's brother, and he was a very subtle man.

questions.text: What did Jonadab tell Amnon to do?
questions.explanation: Jonadab said, "Lay down on your bed, and pretend to be sick."

answers.text: Go to the king and ask for a feast
Lie down on his bed and pretend to be sick
Go out to the sheep shearers

questions.text: What did Tamar make in Amnon's sight?
questions.explanation: Tamar took dough, kneaded it, made cakes in his sight, and baked the cakes.

questions.text: What kind of garment was Tamar wearing?
questions.explanation: She had a garment of various colors on her, for the king's daughters who were virgins dressed in such robes.

questions.text: What did Tamar put on her head as she went away crying?
questions.explanation: Tamar put ashes on her head and tore her garment of various colors.

questions.text: Where did Absalom have sheep shearers when he invited all the king's sons?
questions.explanation: Absalom had sheep shearers in Baal Hazor, which is beside Ephraim.

questions.text: When did Absalom command his servants to strike Amnon?
questions.explanation: Absalom said, "Mark now, when Amnon's heart is merry with wine; and when I tell you, 'Strike Amnon,' then kill him."

answers.text: When Amnon's heart was merry with wine
While Amnon was asleep in his tent
When Amnon went out to the field
At the sound of a trumpet

questions.text: On what did the king's sons ride as they fled?
questions.explanation: All the king's sons arose, and every man got up on his mule, and fled.
Absalom fled and went to Talmai the son of Ammihur, king of Geshur.

questions.text: How long was Absalom in Geshur?
questions.explanation: Absalom fled, went to Geshur, and was there three years.
